grammar.title: A recurring habit with 老是
grammar.explanation: 老是 (lǎoshi) means "always, constantly" often with a complaining or exasperated tone about a repeated habit or problem.

grammar.title: Marking a moment in a story with 这时候
grammar.explanation: 这时候 (zhè shíhou) means "at this moment, at this point in time" used to mark a moment within a story or sequence of events.

sentences.pinyin: Tā lǎoshi wèn tóngyàng de wèntí.
sentences.en: He always asks the same question.
At this moment, it started to rain.

sentences.zh: 这时候，我们才知道原因。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhou, wǒmen cái zhīdào yuányīn.
sentences.en: At this point, we finally knew the reason.

sentences.zh: 这时候，他忽然想起了那件事。
sentences.pinyin: Zhè shíhou, tā hūrán xiǎngqǐ le nà jiàn shì.
sentences.en: At that moment, he suddenly remembered that matter.
